resources.string: The cached library for this server will be deleted from this device, and this phone is signed out of continuo. Your other devices keep working.
Each phone signs in as its own device, and so does a reinstall or a restored backup. Sign out the ones you no longer use. To sign this phone out, remove the server.
This phone was signed out of continuo. Enter your continuo password in Edit server to sign in again.
